newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Sept 11.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Sept 11.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunker prices on Wednesday were softer on weaker cargo prices, traders said. They said prices have eased as cargo prices have fallen near market close on more aggressive offers. Keen competition from South Korea have also lured away buyers, sellers said. Bunker 180-cst was traded at $120.50 and bunker 380-cst between $115. MDO prices were also steady at $202-$208 and gasoil at $217-$220.
